sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B is an on-device agentic model that plans, calls tools, and runs multi-step tasks at 220 tok/s in under 2.5 GB. Open weights on Hugging Face.

sources.title: LFM2.5-2.6B | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B is a 2.6 billion parameter open weight language model built for agentic workflows. It handles planning, tool calling, and multi step tasks, with a 128K context window for long inputs and an expanded 128K token vocabulary for better multilingual support, including non Latin scripts.
